owner_assembly_boundary.fastener_policy: four M2.5 nonconductive screws clamp through four exact 11.00-mm nonconductive stops; enclosure capture lips and anti-shear datums carry ordinary side load
owner_assembly_boundary.compression_stop_geometry: 11.00-mm length, 6.0-mm OD, 2.7-mm unthreaded bore, black polyamide
owner_assembly_boundary.compression_stop_external_route: Buerklin 18H0210; 300 available in 5 days; MOQ 10 on 2026-09-02
owner_assembly_boundary.compression_stop_jlcpcb_result: no exact manufacturer result; generic JLCPCB Assembly C9900280696 rejected because stock is zero, MOQ is 443 and identity is not controlled
owner_assembly_boundary.notes: The owner explicitly accepts post-PCBA display, cable, knob and enclosure assembly. Four exact pass-through stops preserve the Div-like four-long-plastic-screw architecture. H6 selects the exact screw length after both enclosure wall thicknesses are locked; factory installation remains an optional convenience, not a release requirement.

sa818s_v.notes: Stock zero. Pre-order is required. Final quotation and exact lead time are confirmed only after pre-order; over 18 working days triggers continue/cancel-and-refund confirmation. The integer lead-time field records the conservative upper end of the stated typical working-day range. JLCPCB later confirmed that exact C51897911 and C3001549 can each be selected for its own designator in BOM Matching and assembled from Gerber/BOM/CPL.

dual_module_job.notes: JLCPCB confirmed that C51897911 and C3001549 can be assigned to their corresponding separate reference designators and assembled. It did not independently verify the common land geometry or functional isolation of the RF paths; those remain design and owner H7/H8 evidence.

j4_f_operations.description: install and mate one customer-supplied exact ER-TFT035IPS-6 + ER-TPC035-6 option 5344 display flex in the populated FH34SRJ-50S-0.5SH(50) ZIF, then retain the panel with one exact 3M (TC) 4910SQ-2(5) using the released supported-pressure process
j4_f_operations.notes: The exact-one clarification supersedes the original HMX035CTFT-001 wording. The 2026-09-01 display-PSA supplement adds exact pad identity, one untwisted fold, pin-order/slack rules, >=100 kPa uniformly supported pressure and 24-hour pre-pack hold; the donor display and adapter route remain rejected.

j4_f_operations.description: install, strain-route and continuity-test two 30-mm TE Connectivity 2118651-2 and three 60-mm TE Connectivity 1-2118651-0 microcoax jumpers
j4_f_operations.notes: Current exact-one clarification supersedes the original single-MPN five-jumper wording.

j4_f_operations.description: assemble the two-board sandwich and enclosure
j4_f_operations.notes: JLCPCB explicitly states that it does not support complete enclosure/final-device assembly of populated PCBs, spacers and enclosure; the customer must perform it after receiving the PCBA.

j4_f_operations.description: execute the supplied whole-device functional-test procedure

j4_f_operations.notes: Function Test is selectable, but JLCPCB engineers review feasibility and final quotation manually only after order placement. This is not pre-order acceptance of the requested whole-device test.

identity_control.notes: JLCPCB confirms exact customer-supplied/consigned MPN control. If engineering review finds an issue, it emails the customer; Replace Part is enabled only after confirmation and the customer chooses the replacement in Order History.
